crossRefs.note: Moreover Yahweh said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes…
Rise up, you women who are at ease! Hear my voice! You careless daughters, give ear to my speech!
A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.
Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.
Yahweh of Armies says, “Consider, and call for the mourning women, that they may come. Send for the skillful women…
Let them make haste and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears and our eyelids gush out with…

translations.web: Yet hear Yahweh’s word, you women. Let your ear receive the word of his mouth. Teach your daughters wailing. Everyone teach her neighbor a lamentation.
translations.bsb: Now, O women, hear the word of the LORD. Open your ears to the word of His mouth. Teach your daughters to wail, and one another to lament.
translations.kjv: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O ye women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth, and teach your daughters wailing, and every one her neighbour lamentation.
translations.asv: Yet hear the word of Jehovah, O ye women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth; and teach your daughters wailing, and every one her neighbor lamentation.
